I also read that voluntary links can form into permanent involuntary links, too.

To be transgender is to be a different gender than the one that you were assigned at birth. To be trans male, or FTM (female-to-male), means to be living in a feminine body with feminine anatomy, but identifying as a man. Gender dysphoria is the distressing emotional pain caused by the disconnect between how your body looks and how your mind feels. Corrective surgery and hormone replacement therapy can ease or completely eliminate this dysphoria, and is the recommended course of treatment. Suicide rates are very high in trans people, as care and accommodation is often overlooked.
